title: Exterior Painting — An Overlooked High-Margin Trade for Territory Presence
content:
### **A Trade That Gets Overlooked** 

When people think about territory marketing, roofing and HVAC come to mind first. Exterior painting rarely makes the list — which means the companies in this trade who move first face far less competition for the same territory strategy. 

###  **Why It Fits the Model Well** 

Exterior painting is visible, recurring every several years, and highly dependent on trust — a homeowner is inviting a crew to work directly on the outside of their home for days at a time. Familiarity matters enormously. 

###  **An Underpriced Opportunity** 

Because fewer painting companies are thinking about structured neighborhood presence, the cost of building recognition in a given territory is often lower than in more contested trades. 

###  **Worth a Look** 

If exterior painting is your trade, this may be one of the more efficient categories to secure territory in right now.
